item.title: Artist uses 'brush as the microphone' to explore Virginia history at Jamestown exhibit
item.description: Virginia artist Jeromyah Jones explores Hampton Roads history and protest themes in new Jamestown Settlement exhibit running through March 29.

item.title: CBS 6's Greg McQuade calls 'Heroes Among Us - Veterans Voices' event at War Memorial 'huge success'
item.description: CBS 6's Greg McQuade called showcasing more than 25 years of veteran stories at the "Heroes Among Us - Veterans Voices" event Thursday night a career highlight and "huge success."

item.title: Man killed, another critically injured after Henrico apartments shooting, Crime Insider sources say
item.description: One man was killed and another critically injured after a shooting at an apartment complex in Henrico on Sunday evening, Crime Insider sources told Jon Burkett.
